scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind following hyperlinks.
Web browser: opens websites and web pages. Address bar: shows or accepts a website address.
Home page: is the main starting page of a website. Hyperlink: opens another page or resource when selected. Back button: returns to a previously visited page.
Use an imaginary example or a teacher-approved offline screenshot. Discuss when to use web browser and address bar. Never enter a real password or share private details in this activity.
